blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: 3NF — No transitive dependency of non-prime attributes on candidate keys.
transitive dependency — An attribute depends on a key indirectly through another non-key attribute.
functional dependency — Value of one attribute determines another.
update anomaly — Duplicate facts can disagree after an edit.

blocks.text: Under the assumption CustomerID determines the customer's current postcode, there is an indirect dependency OrderID→CustomerID→CustomerPostcode. Store Customer(CustomerID PK,Postcode) and Order(OrderID PK,CustomerID FK). Historical shipping addresses may need separate, deliberate snapshots.
